title: Jobsite Photo Documentation: Organize Proof by Job, Phase, Date, and Crew
author: WNY Business Automation
metaDescription: Build a practical jobsite photo documentation workflow for Western New York crews, with capture rules, naming, privacy, handoffs, access, and retention.
excerpt: A practical guide for roofing, remodeling, painting, and exterior crews to capture, name, review, share, and retain useful jobsite photos without losing context or human control.
image_alt: Exterior crew lead photographs completed siding and roofline details while a project coordinator reviews a jobsite photo checklist.
